lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er4Al2Cu2 (reduced formula Er2AlCu) crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-3m1 (No. 119), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives Al and Cu 12 geometric neighbors each in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Er has 16 neighbors (10 Al, 6 Cu). Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show corner, edge, and face sharing between Al- and Cu-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, plus corner and edge sharing between these and Er-centered 16-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 8 sites.
